description: This file contains functions and logic for managing custom instructions, loading rule files, handling agent rule files, and processing directory contents within a project. It includes file system operations, symlink resolution, and rule management for a code assistant or AI system.

methods.name: safeReadFile
methods.description: Reads a file safely, trimming its content or returning an empty string if not found or error.

methods.name: directoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: resolveDirectoryEntry
methods.description: Recursively resolves directory entries, handling symlinks and collecting file paths.

methods.name: resolveSymLink
methods.description: Resolves a symbolic link, handling nested symlinks and directories.

methods.name: readTextFilesFromDirectory
methods.description: Reads all text files from a directory in alphabetical order, resolving symlinks and filtering binary or cache files.

methods.name: formatDirectoryContent
methods.description: Formats multiple files' contents with relative filenames as headers.

methods.name: loadRuleFiles
methods.description: Loads rule files from global, project-local, and subfolder directories, with fallback to legacy rule files.

methods.name: loadAgentRulesFileFromDirectory
methods.description: Loads agent rules from a specific directory, handling symlinks and optional path display.

methods.name: loadAgentRulesFile
methods.description: Loads agent rules from project root, deprecated in favor of loadAllAgentRulesFiles.

methods.name: loadAllAgentRulesFiles
methods.description: Loads all agent rules files from project root and subdirectories with .roo folders, combining their contents.

methods.name: addCustomInstructions
methods.description: Generates a combined custom instruction string, including rules, agent files, and toggle-based rules, with optional mode and language settings.

methods.name: shouldIncludeRuleFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be included in rules, filtering out cache and system files.
